controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Monochrome: Native clear-filter Voyager frames, corrected independently using source capture geometry before compositing. Missing and unstable geometry stay unavailable.
controls.summary: Each image is corrected using its capture geometry before joining the mosaic. Missing coverage and unreliable views stay empty.
controls.title: Clear-filter mosaic

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Enhanced color: Photometrically corrected 2014 map in orange/green/blue. Northern black background was not illuminated by Voyager; original JPEG fill remains missing. Local source resolution varies.
controls.summary: Orange, green and blue bands form an enhanced-color view. Detail varies; the unlit northern region stays unavailable.
controls.title: Enhanced-color map
